patterns.name: Zero-context resumability
patterns.problem: Long-running work fails when continuation depends on conversation history or individual memory.
patterns.mechanism: Durable state + plan + runbook + zero-context handoff + exact next action.
patterns.portability_gap: Not yet validated in a materially different company.

patterns.name: Bounded execution and checkpointing
patterns.problem: Large tasks are vulnerable to interruption, connector limits, retries, and partial completion.
patterns.mechanism: Deterministic batches, validation, checkpoint after each substantive batch, explicit remaining queue.
patterns.portability_gap: Needs multi-domain validation beyond research/data workflows.

patterns.name: Working plane / durable control plane separation
patterns.problem: Forcing collaboration artifacts and durable operating state into one system creates friction or conflicting truths.
patterns.mechanism: Keep collaborative work in its best-fit system while versioning normalized control state separately.
patterns.portability_gap: Needs validation with tool stacks other than GitHub + Google/SharePoint.

patterns.name: No-dual-canonical rule
patterns.problem: Two editable copies of the same information class create reconciliation debt and hidden divergence.
patterns.mechanism: Declare one authoritative source and explicit replicas/exports/cutover state.

patterns.name: Live-source revalidation before crediting checkpoint state
patterns.problem: External source systems can change after a durable checkpoint, invalidating prior classifications.
patterns.mechanism: Verify current source commit/tree/state and reconcile differences before resuming.
patterns.portability_gap: Needs validation with non-code source systems.

patterns.name: Target accountability versus current execution authority
patterns.problem: Future-state roles cannot authorize present-day transformation work when those roles do not yet exist.
patterns.mechanism: Represent target owner and current executor separately, with explicit delegation.
patterns.portability_gap: New pattern; requires operational use and external validation.

patterns.name: Organizational bootstrap layer
patterns.problem: A transformation can deadlock if the governance structure required to execute it is itself the thing being created.
patterns.mechanism: Narrow temporary stewardship that exists only to bootstrap current-state truth and transition toward target governance.
patterns.portability_gap: Designed but not yet repeatedly exercised.

patterns.name: AI role incubation before human stewardship
patterns.problem: A needed function may not yet have a clear human owner or mature job definition.
patterns.mechanism: Chartered AI role conversation builds/proposes the function while binding authority remains human; later transfer durable state to a human steward.
patterns.portability_gap: Human takeover has not yet been completed in field use.

patterns.name: Proposal/adoption state separation
patterns.problem: Consultants and AI can blur recommendation with authorization.
patterns.mechanism: Explicit draft/proposed/adopted/superseded states and adoption authority.

patterns.name: Dependency-aware process change
patterns.problem: Local process/product changes create untracked downstream consequences.
patterns.mechanism: Employee suggestion -> triage -> candidate impact map -> accountable decision -> linked implementation -> validation -> adoption.
patterns.portability_gap: Dependency graph not yet fully implemented.

patterns.name: Separate truth dimensions
patterns.problem: Organizations collapse different notions of truth into a single convenient status.
patterns.mechanism: Model independent truth dimensions and require evidence appropriate to each dimension.
patterns.portability_gap: General abstraction needs examples outside the source domain.
